description: This file contains utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to specific colors, primarily for visual differentiation in data visualizations within the project. It provides functions to generate deterministic pastel colors from arbitrary strings and to map typical status labels to theme-specific colors, ensuring consistency across charts and UI elements.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel HSL color string based on the input string, producing visually distinct hues suitable for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a theme-specific color, with fallback to a deterministic color if the status is unrecognized.
